question: Should OpenClaw add a duplicate top-level `auth list` namespace when the shipped canonical command is `models auth list` and plugins may already own the `auth` root?
rationale: Code review can verify dispatch mechanics, but it cannot decide whether the convenience alias and its cross-installation ownership semantics are desirable permanent public CLI surface.

options.title: Keep the canonical command
options.body: Decline the alias and retain `openclaw models auth list` as the single documented source of truth without adding a special root-collision rule.

options.title: Sponsor the auth namespace
options.body: Accept a top-level `auth` namespace only after defining its permanent plugin ownership contract, documenting conditional behavior, and obtaining live proof.

recommendation.title: Keep the canonical command
recommendation.body: Decline the alias and retain `openclaw models auth list` as the single documented source of truth without adding a special root-collision rule.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the plugin-root registration and overlap architecture directly affected by this namespace decision.
